en: The image is an illustrated postcard featuring a young girl in traditional German folk costume, holding a basket of flowers and an umbrella. She has a large bow on her head and a decorative hat. Text in German is printed above and next to her, mentioning 'Bad Pyrmont'. The reverse side has a postage stamp from 'Deutsches Reich', a postmark, handwritten message, and additional printed text referring to a museum and the Schloss (castle) in Bad Pyrmont.
